scope: Exact actor-key/task-code source delta. A removed finding is not a completed actor, new gameplay implementation, artistic approval or 1:1 certification.

incarnation.after: Doom (1993) - classic Demon/Pinky (SARG)

visualAnchor.after: Classic Doom pink fleshy Demon: massive hunched torso and low broad jaw, ivory teeth, golden-yellow eyes, short gray temporal horns, short forearms and thick bowed legs with flat dark feet. No armor, mechanical parts, oversized later-game horns or long Doom 2016/Eternal tail. The inherited word Leaping does not grant a jump attack; A_SargAttack is a close-range bite.

incarnation.after: Final Fantasy VII (1997), living party member in original pink dress

visualAnchor.after: Aerith with long brown braid and pink ribbon, short red bolero jacket, pink button-front dress, brown boots and Guard Stick. She uses a staff and healing Limits; no rifle, white wing or later-film costume.

incarnation.after: Final Fantasy VII (1997), original AVALANCHE field outfit

visualAnchor.after: Large muscular dark-skinned Barret with flat-top hair and beard, sleeveless brown vest, green trousers, heavy boots, dog tags and the gun-arm replacing his right forearm. No sunglasses-only Remake model or human right hand gripping a rifle.

incarnation.after: Final Fantasy VII (1997), original battle model and default SOLDIER-style outfit

visualAnchor.after: Adult Cloud with spiky blond hair, blue-green eyes, sleeveless dark violet SOLDIER-style clothing, single left metal pauldron, brown harness/gloves/boots and Buster Sword. No Advent Children sleeve, Fenrir gear or Remake-only costume.

incarnation.after: Final Fantasy VII (1997), original Nanaki quadruped model

visualAnchor.after: Red XIII/Nanaki is a red-furred quadruped with a dark mane, one scarred eye, tattoo XIII, bracelets and a flame-tipped tail. Preserve four-legged locomotion and his head ornaments; no humanoid body, sword or gun.

incarnation.after: Final Fantasy VII (1997), original battle model and Seventh Heaven outfit

visualAnchor.after: Adult Tifa with long dark hair, white cropped tank top, black mini skirt, suspenders, red gloves and red boots; bare-handed martial arts. No Remake pleated skirt or Advent Children leather suit.

incarnation.after: Final Fantasy VII (1997), original red-cloaked party member

visualAnchor.after: Vincent has long black hair and red headband, red high-collared ragged cape, black clothing and gold left gauntlet/boots, carrying the original Quicksilver handgun. No three-barrel Cerberus from Dirge of Cerberus.

after.name: Repli du tireur de la Shinra

incarnation.after: Final Fantasy VII (1997), original Wutai ninja outfit

visualAnchor.after: Teenage Yuffie with short dark hair, green sleeveless crop top, light shorts, headband, asymmetric arm protection and large four-point shuriken. No INTERmission moogle cloak or later Dirge outfit.

after.name: Esquive de la ninja de Wutai

incarnation.after: Final Fantasy VII (1997), Jenova-BIRTH cargo-ship battle

visualAnchor.after: Jenova-BIRTH is the original cargo-ship form, with alien upper body, long red hair and multiple large fleshy tentacles. Keep its appendages separate and avoid Jenova-LIFE/DEATH palettes, SYNTHESIS lower body or a carried gun.

incarnation.after: Final Fantasy VII (1997), marsh serpent encounter near Mythril Mine

visualAnchor.after: Enormous limbless swamp serpent with long coiled body, raised neck, broad fanged head and segmented belly. Preserve the snake body without humanoid torso, arms, rifles or Remake Midgardsormr redesign.

incarnation.after: Final Fantasy VII (1997), Midgar MP security infantry

visualAnchor.after: Shinra MP infantry in the original Midgar security uniform, enclosed helmet with red optics, torso/shoulder armor, trousers and carried firearm. No SOLDIER sword, Remake-only heavy shield or uncovered civilian face.

incarnation.after: Final Fantasy VII (1997), Midgar Sweeper machine

visualAnchor.after: Original Sweeper is a squat bipedal industrial combat machine with armored central chassis, two mechanical legs and paired gun arms. No scorpion tail, human rider or Guard Scorpion body.

incarnation.after: Final Fantasy VIII (1999), original Galbadian sharpshooter outfit

visualAnchor.after: Irvine has long brown tied-back hair, cowboy hat, long pale coat with fur collar, purple shirt, gloves and boots, carrying Valiant rifle. No pistol, gunblade or generic military helmet.

incarnation.after: Final Fantasy VIII (1999), young Galbadian soldier flashback outfit

visualAnchor.after: Young Laguna with shoulder-length dark hair, blue military jacket, light shirt, dark trousers, dog tags and a two-handed machine gun. No presidential suit or older grey-haired redesign.

incarnation.after: Final Fantasy VIII (1999), original instructor field outfit

visualAnchor.after: Quistis has blond tied-back hair, glasses, peach sleeveless high-neck long outfit with belt, dark gloves and boots, and a whip. Preserve her glasses, whip and Blue Magic role; no rifle or gunblade.

incarnation.after: Final Fantasy VIII (1999), blue-knit Forest Owls field outfit

visualAnchor.after: Rinoa with dark shoulder-length hair, blue sleeveless knit duster with white wing motif, black top/shorts, black arm warmers and blue boots. Blaster Edge is mounted on her arm; Angelo remains a separate dog partner, not a laser cannon.

incarnation.after: Final Fantasy VIII (1999), Dollet temporary-party coat

visualAnchor.after: Selphie has short brown outward-flipped hair, sleeveless yellow zip-front dress and boots, using a linked nunchaku. No laser weapon or SeeD parade uniform; Slots outcomes are separate source commands.

incarnation.after: Final Fantasy VIII (1999), casual Balamb field outfit

visualAnchor.after: Young Squall with brown hair, scar between the eyes, black leather jacket with white fur collar, white shirt, black belts/trousers and Revolver gunblade. No SeeD dress uniform, Dissidia redesign or projectile bullets from a sword swing.

incarnation.after: Final Fantasy VIII (1999), original Balamb casual outfit

visualAnchor.after: Small flying insect with rounded abdomen, large compound eyes, paired wings, thin legs and biting mouthparts. It hovers as the original Bite Bug rather than holding a gun, staff or human accessories.

incarnation.after: Final Fantasy VIII (1999), standard Galbadian infantry

visualAnchor.after: Original G-Soldier infantry with closed helmet, blue combat uniform, shoulder armor, boots and a sword. Its original attack family includes sword attacks and low-level magic; no Esthar cyborg limbs, elite red variant or carried rifle.

visualAnchor.after: Huge biped tyrannosaur with large toothed head, long balancing tail, two short forearms and powerful clawed feet. Keep the source creature anatomy and markings, without plate armor, gun or spellcasting staff.

incarnation.after: Final Fantasy XIII (2009), teenage main-game field outfit

incarnation.after: Final Fantasy XIII (2009), main-game Guardian Corps outfit

visualAnchor.after: Lightning has pink side-swept hair, pale sleeveless Guardian Corps coat, dark undershirt, short skirt, red cape, gloves and brown high boots, with Blazefire Saber. No XIII-2 Etro armor or Lightning Returns garb.

incarnation.after: Final Fantasy XIII (2009), main-game pilot outfit

visualAnchor.after: Sazh has a rounded afro, goatee, green pilot coat over a light shirt, dark trousers and two pistols. His chocobo chick stays a small companion, not a projectile or offensive summoned animal.

visualAnchor.after: Lunafreya has blond braided-up hair and a white sleeveless layered main-game dress with waist detail, holding the Oracle's trident as a ceremonial/support implement. No rifle, laser or wedding-dress replacement; healing and blessing remain non-offensive.

incarnation.after: Final Fantasy XV (2016), young pre-timeskip Prince's Fatigues

visualAnchor.after: Young Noctis has spiky black hair, black short jacket and shirt, cropped dark trousers and boots, with Engine Blade. No ten-years-later beard, Kingly Raiment or Armiger Unleashed Royal Edition accessory.

incarnation.after: Final Fantasy XV (2016), standard night-time Iron Giant daemon

visualAnchor.after: Large humanoid daemon in heavy dark iron armor and a horned enclosed helmet, carrying a massive physical greatsword. No Red Giant red color variant, ranged rifle or magical staff replacing the sword.

incarnation.after: Final Fantasy XV (2016), Niflheim Magitek rifle infantry

visualAnchor.after: Humanoid Niflheim Magitek infantry with enclosed helmet/faceplate, segmented artificial limbs, dark imperial armor and carried rifle. This slot selects rifle infantry, not the axe-bearing elite variant, a human Crownsguard or an Astral.

incarnation.after: Half-Life (1998) - Xen bullsquid

visualAnchor.after: Stocky biped Xen bullsquid with thick orange-brown hide, two legs, a heavy tail and red mouth tentacles around the snout. Acid spit leaves the mouth; no humanoid arms, gun or Combine armor.

incarnation.after: Half-Life (1998) - ceiling-attached barnacle

visualAnchor.after: Sessile fleshy Xen barnacle attached to a ceiling, downward mouth and a long hanging sticky tongue. Its source movement is ceiling-fixed; no walking legs or handheld weapon. Ceiling attachment and tongue choreography still require mode-specific visual review.

incarnation.after: Half-Life 2 (2004) - standard Overwatch soldier with AR2

visualAnchor.after: Human-sized standard Combine Overwatch soldier in blue-grey armor, black enclosed gas-mask helmet with pale lenses and an AR2 pulse rifle. No white Elite armor or exposed Resistance face.

incarnation.after: Half-Life (1998) - Houndeye, pack encounter abstraction

visualAnchor.after: Stocky three-legged Houndeye with brown-yellow hide, pale belly and one large compound eye at the front. Sonic rings are centered on the animal; the legacy Pack label does not certify several bodies in one sprite.

incarnation.after: Half-Life 2 (2004) - poison zombie host

visualAnchor.after: Bulky hunched human poison zombie in a worn jacket, carrying dark poison headcrabs across the shoulders and back, with one grasped for throwing. Preserve the distinct crab shapes; no green fire breath or ordinary bare zombie head.

incarnation.after: Mass Effect 3 (2012), Alliance officer Ashley

incarnation.after: Mass Effect 2 (2010), Garrus after Archangel recruitment

visualAnchor.after: Mass Effect 2 Garrus after Archangel recruitment: tall male turian with swept cranial plates, facial blue markings, recruitment scars and damaged blue-black armor, visor and M-92 Mantis sniper rifle. Overload is tech; his personal cover does not generate an allied barrier.

visualAnchor.after: Mass Effect 2 Mordin Solus: adult salarian with tall orange-tan head, distinct facial markings, white-blue STG scientist suit and wrist omni-tool. Incinerate is a finite orange thermal tech discharge from that tool, not a rifle or a sustained beam.

incarnation.after: Mass Effect 2 (2010), male default Shepard, Soldier

incarnation.after: Mass Effect 2 (2010)

visualAnchor.after: Mass Effect 2007 Wrex: very broad krogan with high ridged crest, red face markings and scars, heavy red armor over a dark undersuit, shotgun and wrist omni-tool. Barrier protects Wrex personally; ME3 Vanguard Biotic Charge is not part of this ME1 kit.
